response.overview: The documentary 'Nutrition' depicts the stories of residents in Yeongyang-gun, Gyeongsangbuk-do, who lost their homes to a wildfire. Like resilient roots breathing beneath burnt earth, these individuals endure, cultivating life amidst adversity. Through the actions of a food truck owner offering meals, the film explores 'nutrition' beyond food, encompassing human connection and nature's cycle. It presents a message of life's inherent strength and regeneration, observing how fundamental vitality persists and re-emerges even in the wake of devastation.
response.title: Nutrition
